1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Jalan Persekutuan

(Persimpangan Bertingkat Sungai Buaya) 2014.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 9 Januari 2014.

Perisytiharan jalan sebagai jalan Persekutuan

2. (1) Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Persimpangan Bertingkat Sungai

Buaya yang bermula di kilometer 435.89 di koordinat U372323.067, T395477.970 Grid

Rectified Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir di kilometer

433.64 di koordinat U374392.997, T396007.082 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000)

Lebuh Raya Utara Selatan (kedua-dua jarak diukur dari kilometer 0.0 Lebuh Raya Utara

Selatan di Bukit Kayu Hitam) termasuklah Plaza Tol Masuk/Keluar Sungai Buaya dan

jalan sambungannya dan berakhir di koordinat U373216.605, T394451.869 Grid RSO

Geosentrik (GDM 2000), diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan.

(2) Jalan yang diisytiharkan sebagai jalan Persekutuan di bawah

subperenggan (1) ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual.

FEDERAL ROADS ACT 1959

FEDERAL ROADS (SUNGAI BUAYA INTERCHANGE) ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 3 of the Federal Roads Act 1959

[Act 376], the Minister, after consultation with the State Government of Selangor,

makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Sungai Buaya

Interchange) Order 2014.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 9 January 2014.

Declaration of road to be Federal road

2. (1) The part of the road known as the Sungai Buaya Interchange commencing

at kilometre 435.89 at coordinates N372323.067, E395477.970 of Rectified Skew

Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid and ending at kilometre 433.64 at

coordinates N374392.997, E396007.082 of RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid of the

North South Expressway (both distances measured from kilometre 0.0 of the North

South Expressway at the Bukit Kayu Hitam) including the Sungai Buaya Entry/Exit Toll

Plaza and its link road and ending at coordinates N373216.605, E394451.869 of RSO

Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid, is declared to be a Federal road.

 (2) The road declared to be a Federal road under subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Schedule.
